verdict.rationale: Langfuse is an LLM engineering platform with an LLM Playground and experiments, so consuming tools from MCP servers is a plausible capability and the axis applies. The pack shows no evidence that Langfuse can connect to external MCP servers as a client. The MCP evidence (docs-mcp, the 'MCP Server' entry) describes Langfuse serving as an MCP server for other AI tools, which is the opposite role and earns no credit here.
